# REVL programming — raw extracted screenshot data (Step 1)

Auto-generated by `source/extract_revl.py`. Two independent readers per image:
**rapidocr-onnxruntime** and **Apple Vision** (both active).

> **How to read this file.** These posters use heavily stylised type over
> photos. Both engines misread numbers, drop small print and lose word
> spacing. Lines the two engines disagree on are marked `[?]`. The
> *Structured parse* is a keyword heuristic, **LOW CONFIDENCE** by design.
> Downstream analysis must treat any specific load, %, rep count, tempo or
> cap here as *approximate* — cross-check against the image, never state as
> fact. Phase / week / day / session headers are **inferred from folder and
> file names** (flagged `[inferred]`).
